description: This file defines a `Trend` class that provides methods to plot trend-related technical indicators (ADX and Aroon) using Plotly figures. It imports external modules such as pandas and other components from the openbb_charting package, and it contains method definitions decorated as indicators for plotting the ADX and Aroon indicators on financial charting figures.

classes.name: Trend
classes.description: A class for adding trend-related technical indicator plots (ADX, Aroon) to a Plotly figure.

methods.name: plot_adx(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Adds the ADX trend indicator plot on a given subplot within an OpenBBFigure.

methods.name: plot_aroon(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Adds the Aroon indicator plots, including Aroon Up, Down, and Oscillator, to a specified subplot within an OpenBBFigure.
